title: App Studio 改版（4-3）：服务端拒绝没有软件包的新建（只留四类豁免，原地保存照旧）；先实测元数据接口存流程能当场注册，再下线自动化接口的新建
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzywxH36FPH6ayWMUe

Filing gate: ③ · Source: topic #37424 (ruling 7184753035, question 2 answered A, the maintainer's 「同意」 of 2026-11-26T06:44Z; ADR-0084 `#amendment-2026-11-26-org`, section from line 470, "A create with no package asks for one, and the kernel refuses it"; the writer census in #37453 comment 7184476778). Phase order as ruled: this kernel PR is last, in the same phase as the UI ask, with no flag. That the move door lands before it comes from the takeover plan (#37424 comment 7216856007). Sub-issue of #37424 (phase 4).
Grade: area:package · Feature · p2 · evidence: read on origin/main 815e882b and rechecked at 33a0d4fa: of the cited files only `mcp-authoring.ts` moved (two comment edits), and its cited lines are corrected below. The rest are unchanged since 7e4df284. The kernel accepts a package-less create: #37453 measured it at a46efa8c as W1 (`PUT /meta/flow`, `/meta/object` and `/meta/dataset` all `200`), and the code path is unchanged (lines below). The area is `package`, not the topic's `ux`, because every file this card edits is the package zone's server half: the save door and its refusals in `packages/metadata-protocol`, the automation definition doors in `packages/runtime`, `os meta register` in `packages/cli`, and a migration entry in `packages/spec`. #37468 was triaged `area:package · domain:server` for the same door family. No `ui/` file changes here.
Reader: a seat card thread (seat repo:objectstack#3).
- **Build tier:** the default judgment tier.
- **Review tier:** one contract-review-tier review before the queue, because this card is a narrowing (`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`; `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:13270–13273`). It also owes an ADR-0087 disposition. Its ADR marks (ADR-0070, and the ADR-0084:475 amendment the answers owe) are Tier H, so the maintainer merges. It carries decisions Q-a (A), Q-b (C), Q-d (A) and Q-g (C) as answered (see Ruled). Q-g C rests on a premise NOT MEASURED; What 3 measures it first, and if it fails the card stops and asks the maintainer before any write.
Blocked-by: #38149, #38150
Dedupe: searched `"package-less" create`, `writable_package_required`, `"os meta register" package`, `"sharing rules" ".custom"`, `automation.create` (issues, open and closed). Hits:
- #37424, the topic;
- #37453, the census (closed);
- #23350, `os meta register --package` (closed);
- #34777, `--mode draft` needs a package (closed);
- #37608 and #37499, package-less writes over disabled holders (closed);
- #28413, `os migrate` moves package-less overlays into the pair (closed);
- #23292 and #23501, the automation doors' no-package rule and its remedy (closed).

None closes the package-less create.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：任何入口（接口、命令行、自动化接口）要新建一个不属于任何软件包的配置时，服务端直接拒绝，并列出可以写进去的软件包。已经存在的散落项照常可以原地保存。只有四类写入照旧：系统自带内容上的定制、外部数据源导入、迁移、平台自己的注册。
- 为什么：界面先问软件包、移入入口先上线，这张卡最后把服务端的口子关上，以后不再产生新的散落项。
- 需要你做的：开工前不需要你裁，你 11 月 28 日已经答了 Q-a、Q-b、Q-d、Q-g。Q-g 选的「下线自动化接口的新建」有个前提要先实测：通用的元数据接口存流程时，是否同样当场注册、立即能跑、报同样的错。实测不过，施工就停，先回来问你。Q-d 的答案要更正架构决定记录里你 11 月 26 日写的「共享规则等绑定到所属对象的定制包」那句，这条更正和其他标注都由你合并。这张卡是破坏性收紧，合并前要合约审查。

## Ruled (not reopened)

- Ruling 7184753035, question 2 (A), verbatim: "When the kernel closes package-less creates (ADR-0070 D1), only four writers keep a named exemption: kernel-item overlays until the platform-pair whitelist (W3), the ruled external-datasource import (W4, server-stamped `writeFace: 'external-import'`), binding-preserving migrations (W12) and platform registration (W13). Everything else closes, `os meta register` included (it takes `--package` like every author door). The UI ask (create with no package asks to pick or create one) and the kernel close ship in the same phase, the kernel PR last, no flag."
- Same record: "Sibling rulings carried with it: in-place saves of existing loose rows stay open; organization-authored sharing rules, queues and assignment rules in Setup bind to the owning object's `.custom` package, with no new exemption (their write path is to be traced when the card is cut)."
- The maintainer in the project thread, verbatim: 「一、不开工作区定制包，「没地方放」的情形怎么处理，就按照你的方案」. The plan it approves sets decisions `Q-a` A, `Q-b` C and `Q-d` A. The seat recorded it on #37424 (comment 7234139193).
- The maintainer on the seat's Q-f / Q-g card, verbatim: 「两条都按建议」, so `Q-g` C (retire the create half of the automation doors, on the premise above). Recorded on #37424 (comment 7234518908).
- The platform customization pair and the kernel whitelist raised under Q-b are held as #38172. Q-b C stands for this phase.
- ADR-0084 `#amendment-2026-11-26-org` (474: no default catch-all; 475: the exemptions): "Four writers keep a named exemption, and no other … `os meta register` is closed with the rest. … Saving a loose row that already exists, in place, stays open." And: "ADR-0070 is not edited by this amendment. Where the ruling restates its D1 and D5, the phase-4 cards that carry the ruling out owe that record its marks."
- ADR-0070 D1: "A runtime **create** … MUST resolve to a **writable** `package_id`. The kernel write path is the enforcement point of last resort". And: "`null` / `sys_metadata`-scope ceases to be a *write* destination for new items."

## Measured on main

### The kernel's create path today

1. **`ProtocolSaveFacet.saveMetaItemUnaudited`** (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts:345`).
   - D1 (2108–2180) judges only a named package: `intent === 'runtime-only' && request.packageId != null && !host.isWritablePackage(...)` (2171–2174).
   - The comment at 2129–2131: "A `null` packageId is still accepted here (legacy org-overlay destination); ADR-0070 D5 retires it once the surfaces always resolve a base and the orphan migration has run."
2. **What already tells a create from an in-place save.**
   - `namedNoPackage` (813).
   - `packagelessAddress` (815–820; `protocol-environment-rows.ts:181–205` returns `{ packageId, candidates, unbound }`).
   - The draft address with `followedBase` (938–975).
   - `artifactBacked` / `intent` (2102–2106).
   - So a create is: no package named, intent `runtime-only`, no stored candidate, and no package-less row active or draft. Every other package-less save is in place, or it customizes a holder (ADR-0150 D4), and it is unchanged.
3. **Refusal text that still prescribes package-less.**
   - `protocol-package-scope.ts:113–115` ("…or with no package.") and 128–133 ("…or save the TYPE without naming a package.");
   - `packages/cli/src/commands/meta/register.ts:26–28` ("or omit --package …");
   - the docs page `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx`, which teaches a package-less save.
4. **A precedent shape for the refusal.** The MCP draft door refuses a save naming no package and names the writable packages: `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.ts:109`, 934–935, and `packageRequiredMessage` at 1459.

### The four exemptions, as main carries them

5. **W3, kernel-item overlays.** `packagelessOverlayWriteRefusal` (`protocol-save.ts:515–547`). An overlay is intent `override-artifact` (2104–2106), so a create-only close never reaches it. Pin it with a control test. Decisions Q-b answered C: a create in a system app does not count, and is refused.
6. **W4, external import.** `packages/services/service-datasource/src/plugin.ts:321–334` (`writeFace` at 329). It is server-stated, and no wire body is read into it (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts:1313`).
7. **W12, binding-preserving migrations.** `source: 'migrate-stored'`: `migrateStoredMetadata` (`protocol-save.ts:2591`) and `flow-credential-migration.ts:222–229`. `source` is not on the wire (`protocol.zod.ts:1182–1189`). Both re-save stored rows. The close exempts `request.source !== undefined` by name.
8. **W13, platform registration.** `MetadataManager.register(…, { origin: 'platform' })` (`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts:1340`) writes the metadata service's own store. The close does not reach it. The census in Acceptance checks the other `register()` callers.

### Writers the close starts refusing (from #37453, re-read)

9. **W1**: `/meta/:type/:name` PUT, publish and draft, naming no package, for a new name.
10. **W2**: the automation definition doors. `registerAndSaveFlow` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts:2779`), called by `POST /api/v1/automation` (4335; ledger `route-ledger.ts:605`, `automation.create`) and `PUT /api/v1/automation/:name` (5448; ledger 668). "No package, because no caller here holds one" (2737). `flowWriteRefusal` already rewrites the protocol's remedy (#23501, 2749–2756). Their consumers are tests and QA steps: 7 dogfood files, runtime door tests, 17 QA checklist items, 7 hotcrm test files, and 3 docs pages (decisions Q-g). `automation.create` has callers in SDK tests only. No UI, CLI or skill uses either door. The clone (4738) lands in a package already (#28149). What these doors become is decisions Q-g.
11. **W11**: `os meta register`. It already takes `--package` (`register.ts:260–268`, #23350), required only for `--mode draft` (116–119; 38–40). A publish-mode run naming none sends no package (328).
12. **W5–W10**: the UI writers, closed in the UI by #38149. This card is their backstop.
13. **AI drafts (cloud).** No card of this phase changes that interface. This close refuses them only once cloud runs a framework release that carries it.

### Organization-authored sharing rules, queues and assignment rules (the write path traced; decisions Q-d)

14. **Code-only metadata types.** `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts:1324` (`sharing_rule`), 1334 (`queue`) and 1341 (`assignment_rule`) are all `allowRuntimeCreate: false, allowEnvironmentOverlay: false`. The comment at 1325–1333 says "A runtime `sys_metadata` item is neither, so the type is code-only." Migration `18.sharing-rule-runtime-create-withdrawn` records the shipped tightening. So no `.custom` binding is possible through the metadata door.
15. **The organization's own are data rows** (regime C: ADR-0131 D6 note at 549; ADR-0142 D1 270–283 and D5 469).
    - Setup opens object pages (`sharing-plugin.ts:748, 750, 752`).
    - Writes go through the data door with `rule-hooks.ts`, `queue-hooks.ts` and `assignment-rule-hooks.ts`, through `POST /api/v1/sharing/rules`, and through the clone dialog (`SharingRuleCloneDialog.tsx:121`).
    - `sys_queue` has no owning object (`sys-queue.object.ts:8–10`). `sys_assignment_rule` has no package column. `sys_sharing_rule.package_id` is "Nothing reads it yet and no writer stamps it" for an organization's own rule (291–292, the comment's claim).
    - So the close never meets these rows.

## What

1. **The close**, in `saveMetaItemUnaudited`, beside D1.
   - **What it refuses.** A save that names no package, has intent `runtime-only`, finds no stored candidate and no package-less row (item 2), and is not exempt. It is refused before anything is written.
   - **The answer.** `422`, `code: 'WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED'` (D1's code; a sibling code only with a stated reason), `docs: 'docs/adr/0070-package-first-authoring.md'`. Its sentence names the type and name, and lists the writable packages it may name, capped, as `packageRequiredMessage` does.
   - **Exempt by name.**
     - W4: `writeFace === 'external-import'`;
     - W12: `source !== undefined`;
     - W3: intent `override-artifact`.
   - No other exemption: Q-a was answered A and Q-b C, so neither adds a type or a case.
   - W13 is off this path, and a comment says so. No flag and no environment switch.
2. **Refusal text.** Rewrite `protocol-package-scope.ts:113–115` and 128–133 so no sentence prescribes saving with no package. Rewrite the D1 comment at `protocol-save.ts:2129–2131`. Rewrite the package-less passage of `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx`.
3. **Automation definition doors, per decisions Q-g (answered C).**
   - **First, before any write, measure the premise.** `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/NAME?package=PKG` must register the flow in the same boot, arm it at once, and give the same registration refusals as `POST /automation`: graph, node config, `start` node and notify channel. `packaged-flow-write-door-parity` and `managed-content-sealed` already compare the doors on refusals. If the premise fails, stop with no PR and ask the maintainer through the seat (the decision named A as the better answer then).
   - **Retire `POST /api/v1/automation`.** Remove:
     - its ledger row (`route-ledger.ts:605`) and its mount;
     - the SDK `automation.create` (`packages/client/src/index.ts:6409`);
     - the spec contract entry `createFlow` (`packages/spec/src/api/automation-api.zod.ts:1011–1016`) and `CreateFlowRequestSchema` / `CreateFlowResponseSchema` (127–146), then regenerate the five baselines (`packages/spec/{api-surface,authorable-surface,export-origins,declaration-map,json-schema.manifest}/api.json`);
     - the docs: the `CreateFlowRequest` section of `content/docs/references/api/automation-api.mdx` (from 170), `content/docs/api/plugin-endpoints.mdx:54`, and `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` (about 2814).

     Every test that drives the route moves to `/meta` with a package, or is replaced by name (AGENTS.md).
   - **`PUT /automation/:name` updates existing flows only.** It takes over `POST`'s overwrite of a name the engine already holds (`automation.ts:4330–4331`). A new name is refused, relaying `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/NAME?package=PKG` through `flowWriteRefusal`, and the engine registration is undone as for any refused save.
   - Update the 2737 docblock.
4. **`os meta register`.** The flag stays optional, because in-place saves stay open.
   - The kernel's refusal is printed as sent.
   - Rewrite the flag's description (`register.ts:263–268`): required for a new item.
   - Rewrite the empty-value refusal (26–28).
   - Add a test: a new item without `--package` exits non-zero with the server's sentence.
5. **Q-d (answered A).** Add a note in `sys-sharing-rule.object.ts` and the PR: the close does not reach these rows (items 14–15).
6. **ADR-0084 amendment (Tier H).** Add a dated note under `#amendment-2026-11-26-org` (line 475), recording what the answers change:
   - Q-d A corrects "Sharing rules, queues and assignment rules … bind to the `.custom` package of the object that owns them" to: they are organization data rows the close does not reach (regime C).
   - Q-a A and Q-b C change no other ADR-0084 sentence. The #35624 record for Q-b C is posted (7234145174).
   - This dated note is the "new ADR or amended status line" AGENTS.md Prime Directive 13 requires to reverse a recorded decision.
7. **ADR-0070 marks (Tier H).**
   - D1: a dated note that the kernel refuses the package-less create, naming the four exemptions and the in-place rule (ruling 7184753035).
   - Implementation status: D1 complete. D3's Kernel bullet: done.
   - Not D5 (#38150 marks it).
8. **Changeset and declarations.**
   - Packages: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/client`, `@objectstack/spec`.
   - `minor`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, the BREAKING banner and its ADR-0087 disposition.
   - A semantic migration entry in `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/` on the precedent of `18.sharing-rule-runtime-create-withdrawn.ts`:
     - FROM: `PUT /api/v1/meta/TYPE/NAME` naming no package, for a name no package holds, answered `200` and stored a loose row (and `POST /automation` created a package-less flow).
     - TO: `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` naming the writable packages. Add `?package=PKG` or `--package PKG`, or in Studio choose a package. Existing loose rows save in place.
   - The PR body carries the `Skills-docs:` line (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:316`) for the narrowing arm.

## Test fixtures and follow-ups

- **Creating a loose item in tests.** After this card, no public door creates a loose item. Tests that need one insert the row directly through the engine with the system context, as `packages/qa/dogfood/test/flow-shipped-name-layered-read.dogfood.test.ts:204` does (`store.insert('sys_metadata', …, { context: SYSTEM_CTX })`). This applies to this card's control tests, to #38150's tests, and to the QA items that read `_env` addresses (`api-backend.json:3750, 3899`). The insert is a test fixture, not a fifth exemption. A #38150 test that creates through a public package-less door turns red here and is fixed in this PR.
- **QA checklist drift.** 17 items in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas` create flows through `POST /api/v1/automation` precisely because "no writable package needed" (for example `approvals.json:1117`). After this card they need a package or the fixture. Other items still describe package-less saves. Drift does not block a PR (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md:15`), so the PR records one follow-up in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/FOLLOW-UPS.md`, or files a checklist-accuracy card.
- **Follow-up card in hotcrm, `Blocked-by:` this card.** Q-g C makes it owed. At c9d500f, seven hotcrm test files (for example `test/flow-record-change.test.ts:763`) register throwaway flows through `POST /automation` with no package, and the close refuses that. They move to `PUT /meta/flow/NAME?package=PKG`. The seat files the card per `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/cross-repo-coordination.md`. The cloud repo was not measured.

## Acceptance

- **Census at the construction SHA.** Re-run #37453's writer census: every caller of `saveMetaItem`, `client.meta.saveItem` or `MetadataManager.register`, and every writer of `sys_metadata`. Each is package-naming, one of the four exemptions (each pinned by a test that names it), in place, or refused here. New writers are listed on the PR.
- Refusal tests, each answering `422` and storing nothing, for a new name with no package:
  - `/meta` publish and draft (`flow`, `object`, `dataset`, `view`);
  - the automation doors (`POST /automation` answers `404`, `PUT /automation/NEW` answers `422`), with the premise measurement on the PR;
  - `os meta register`.
- Control tests, unchanged answers:
  - an in-place publish save, draft save, delete and per-item publish of an existing loose row;
  - a package-less row bearing a package-held name (ADR-0150 D4);
  - the disabled-holder cells of ADR-0150 D3's 2026-11-26 note;
  - the W3 overlay close;
  - the W4 import with a package-less datasource;
  - `os migrate meta --stored` and the flow-credential move over a loose row;
  - platform registration at boot;
  - `PUT /automation/EXISTING`.
- The 7 dogfood files and the runtime door tests that drive `POST /automation` each name, in the PR, what replaces them: the `/meta` door with a package, or the fixture.
- Each new refusal test has an ablation: remove the close, and it goes green-to-red.
- The dogfood battery for a `(narrowing)` arm runs green. The five examples boot and seed with 0 refusals (#37453 measured 0 stored loose rows at boot).
- Contract-tier L2 recorded. The ADR-0084 amendment and the ADR-0070 marks are merged by the maintainer. #38149 and #38150 have landed.
